name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd
title: Pearl Global Industries Ltd - 532808 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FY26 group EBITDA 9.3% (10.3% ex-tariff and ramp-up losses) on revenue ₹5,025 crore; capacity now 101m pieces with FY28 target 125–130m and ₹200–250 crore FY27 capex, but no hard demand visibility on new capacity.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization improved to 80% plus in the current year compared to 63% of last year.

capex.quote: we are in the process of outlining capex commitment of INR200 crores to INR250 crores for FY '27 across geographies.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ₹200–250 crore outlined
triggers.quote: we are in the process of outlining capex commitment of INR200 crores to INR250 crores for FY '27 across geographies.

triggers.label: Vietnam utilisation 63% → 80%+
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization improved to 80% plus in the current year compared to 63% of last year.

triggers.label: Tariff cost ₹36 crore; ~₹5–8 crore to continue
triggers.quote: maybe the 36 number will come down significantly, may not be 0 with U.S. specifically.

triggers.label: Working-capital days up to 43
triggers.quote: Working capital days stood at 43 days as on 31 March 2026.

guidance.quote: we are pretty confident at this stage to really maintain 10% EBITDA for the full year as we start FY '27.
12% to 14% is something like we have been talking about as a CAGR that we have planned.
we should be able to have breakeven in FY '27.
our effort is to have high single -digit EBITDA for the full year.
we should be having established capacity of anywhere between 125 million to 130 million

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our installed capacity has crossed 100 million pieces milestone, significantly ahead of our earlier target of H1 FY '27.
The ongoing capex project is expected to be completed in first half of 2027

red_flags.label: Capex beyond guidance possible
red_flags.quote: There may be more capex beyond INR250 crores as well, which is outlined for FY '27.

red_flags.label: Unquantified tariff pass-through in pricing
red_flags.quote: very difficult to quantify from the point of view of how much the tariff cost will actually translates

evasions.quote: whether a customer has committed a number to us for this extra additional 25 million to 30 million over the next 2 years
unfortunately, that's not visible to me as yet.
